summary: The Global Earth Channel transforms raw NASA satellite data into 06 Live 60 FPS Screens, separating weather noise from statistically significant trends (Mann-Kendall p < 0.05) at $0.00 API cost. Unifying MODIS, POWER, EMIT 285-band, NISAR, GRACE-FO, and PACE under an autonomous COCK-PIT, it protects lives, saves 40% agricultural water, and maps critical minerals.
details:
Transforming the NASA Satellite Fleet into 06 Live Screens for Governments, Civil Defense, Agribusiness, and Citizens at $0.00 API Cost

Our Clear Destination: Answer in real time the 4 core questions of the official challenge “Be an Earth Systems Trend Detective!” (What is changing, Where it is changing, How much it is changing, and whether it has Scientific Significance p < 0.05) by uniting live orbital video (upper 50% of each Screen) and audited statistical telemetry (lower 50%), with all command and management centralized in our COCK-PIT. “Change is constant in Earth's interconnected environmental system, and when it occurs in a consistent direction — upward or downward, increasing or decreasing, thickening or thinning — measured variables reflect it. However, an Earth science data variable may show a trend in one region and the opposite in another, even when the same process drives both. The multiplicity of Earth science data variables makes it challenging to select variables that may indicate changes, and then conduct an analysis on the selected variables. Your challenge is to create a tool to select variables measured by Earth science missions or produced by Earth science models, visualize how they change over time, and determine what is changing, where it is changing, how much it is changing, and whether those changes are what scientists call 'significant'.”
